title: Review: Sol fresh full review of PR #656 after the keep-typed/DM-adjudicated triage restructure
description: Fresh full read-only review of PR #656 after restructure eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6.6 (user's keep-typed/DM-adjudicated triage, bd memory magic-item-faithful-or-absent) plus the captain's equipment DNF shape. Exact head recorded at dispatch. VERDICT line at end.
notes:
Dispatched gpt-6.1-sol effort high at exact head a357cf216b9908f22edf6facf08d726d8a9fc603; PGID 3561753
FRESH FULL REVIEW of PR #656 at exact head a357cf216b9908f22edf6facf08d726d8a9fc603; profile rules-clause-complete + semantic-system. The user-approved 2026-10-12 triage controls; adjudicated categories are correct dispositions when their governing text is carried verbatim, and the unadopted per-ability contract layer is not an approval condition.

Independent census: 362 operations; 150 economy pools; 264 activation costs, 48 commandWord fields, 124 equipment fields; 24 machines / 54 states / 103 transitions; 29 grants in 16 blocks; one Iron Flask occupancy core; three stored-level spellStore cores; no rollManipulation blocks. The 166 changed records are all magic items; descriptions and mechanics.effects are unchanged. Reviewed compiler order, patch/withholding ownership, variant merging, source spans, schema validation, registry/inventory and changed test evidence, and the named runtime consumers.

Validation, all read-only: seven importer/schema/pack suites passed (486 tests: magicItemTriage, magicItemOperationSourceAgreement, magicItemEffectSourceAgreement, alternativeOptionProjections, magicItemMechanicsSchema, magicItemLegacyCapabilityBacklog, srdGeneratedPack); six runtime/discovery suites passed (135 tests: itemState, itemResetExecutor, usageCounters, magicItemVariants, discoveryStages, projectionLimitProvenance). Both commands used npx --no-install vitest run with --no-cache --configLoader runner --maxWorkers 1. npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack regenerated only in scratch and matched the committed pack and all five sibling artifacts exactly. Inventory --check passed (1852 rows). git diff --check passed. No repository edits, formatter, full worktree verification, commit, push, GitHub comment or merge.

RUNTIME SAFETY: independently recomputed deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady against origin/main (1055 combinations), the previous reviewed 7d150a3c head (1049), and this head (1049), also enumerating transition-via identities. Exactly the SAME 19 identities pass: Ammunition hit-target; Boots of Levitation cast-levitate; Candle burn; the 14 Ioun Stone variant grab-orbiting-stone operations; Ring of Shooting Stars discharge-ball-lightning; Rope of Entanglement escape-rope. Withheld blocks retain operation-bound engine-pending clauses rather than freeing their operations. use_item preflights before initialization/mutation; generic spend_usage/restore_usage/reset_usage reject canonical pack-bound item counters. itemResetExecutor still validates licensed timers/reset shapes; itemRandomInitialization still has its Iron Flask occupancy and three spellStore initialization cores. Discovery still presents source prose, projection limits and the bounded readiness capability, not a claim of complete item execution. No new executable operation was found.

SOURCE-SPAN / TEST DISPOSITION: all 333 adjudicated clauses have nonempty verbatim substrings of final descriptions; all 289 previous requirement/trigger/target fragments occur in carried adjudicated spans. The former .6.5 examples Helm wearing, Hammer property attunement, Shackles size/designated-remover and Shooting Stars movement are repaired or correctly adjudicated. Apparatus/Eversmoking/Dancing Sword/Broom topology and Pipes/Python/Iron Flask control/exclusivity policy are intentionally adjudicated; prior exact source claims survive in printed-span evidence. The three new cooldown anchors name the correct departure/disappearance/serving-grant ending events, and initiation/depletion siblings retain their distinct clocks. Changed graph/trigger/containment/spellStore/sight-cohort/DC/count expectations are generally justified by the approved disposition and verbatim replacements, rather than by current output. The Sun Blade ungated-equipment assertion is an exception (S1). Census and lexical tests do not certify semantic operation admission or quantity roles (S2-S4). The generated inventory is current and discloses its field-level classification limits; prose-only registry entries accurately identify Bag of Devouring and Efficient Quiver. No separate registry/inventory finding.
S1 — Kept activation fields are omitted when the printed gate/cost was not already in a producer-draft activation string.
Invariant/authority: user-approved faithful-or-absent triage, explicit whole-corpus/no-kept-category-dropped instruction for this review, owning 19.4.6/.6.6 and capability .9/.10. Printed action type and equipment prerequisites of SELECTED operations must be represented in the kept fields; treating an explicit kept prerequisite as ordinary DM inference defeats that selection. This is not a request to type adjudicated target/trigger conditions or introduce new abilities.

Members:
(a) Sun Blade manifest-blade and dismiss-blade: records.json:140857 and :140863; printed sentence :140829 says "While grasping the hilt" for both bonus-action alternatives, yet both activations contain cost only, and the item has NO adjudicated span carrying that sentence. Producer magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:790-802 never supplies the requirement; magicItemTriage.ts:1135-1138 returns/derives from draft fields rather than finding this printed gate. magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts:1375-1397 explicitly requires equipment absent, citing an older review's weapon-wielding assumption. At .10's selected boundary, possessing an inventory hilt without grasping it satisfies the emitted equipment contract; possession is not held state (useItem currently checks custody, not hands).
(b) Scarab of Protection turn-failed-save-into-success: records.json:130488; the source at :130473 introduces BOTH benefits under "while it is on your person", but the reaction operation has no on-person equipment. magicItemFaithfulOperationsCorpus.ts:796-805 carries only the local failed-save trigger. Its adjudicated spans likewise omit that governing header. A stored/off-person scarab with charges meets the typed equipment contract.
(c) Ring of Spell Turning m10-reflect-spell: records.json:125436; source :125432 grounds "the save" in the wearing-ring sentence, but the operation has no worn gate. Corpus.ts:721-743 and WITHHELD/triage spans carry only the "In addition" natural-20 sentence. An unworn ring would meet the selected equipment contract for an ordinary qualifying save.
(d) Non-spell printed action costs are also absent: Dragon Scale Mail sense-nearest-dragon (records.json:99211; source :99193 explicitly "as an action") and Well of Many Worlds open-portal (:147005; source :146984 explicitly "use an action"). Neither operation has activation.cost. Unlike ordinary spell casting time, no spell-normal fallback supplies these costs, and .9 expressly binds activation.cost and spends nothing automatically when it is absent.

Sibling sweep: examined all 362 parent/variant operations against printed action/equipment sentences, including headers, local qualifications, trigger-qualified wear, attunement and on-person clauses. Talisman worn OR held DNF is correct, as are Helm ignite worn and Hammer Giant's Bane attuned; ending an animation or spell does not automatically inherit its initiating holding/wearing gate. The current omission screen checks cast- operations only, and cue-in-the-item evidence cannot detect these absent fields.

Closure: repair these already-selected operations' kept fields from the printed governing passages; carry the missing governing spans verbatim and replace the Sun Blade no-equipment expectation. Sweep the same draft-only/header/wording failure class without inferring new unprinted equipment restrictions. Permanent evidence: a generalized kept-field agreement invariant with source-backed eligible/ineligible held, on-person, inherited-worn and non-spell-action cases; this is cheap bounded evidence, not a per-ability contract platform or a natural-language theorem prover. Owner 19.4.6; material compiler/pack repair, fresh full review of the resulting head. Current affected operations remain blocked; no green operation regression is alleged.
S2 — Two KEPT machines still encode unprinted active-state admission and instance restrictions (the previous S2 defect class survives the restructure).
Invariant/authority: faithful-or-absent; user-approved kept-state-machine triage; owning 19.4.6 and staged duration capability .11; each printed ability. A kept machine's from/to/via/timer contract must allow source-permitted uses and preserve the lifetime's owner. Two states and verbatim termination words do not establish a simple-toggle invariant. itemState.ts:1518-1523 makes absence of a matching from edge an operative rejection, even though current readiness still blocks these operations before execution.

Members:
(a) Staff of Swarming Insects: records.json:135689 permits create-insect-cloud only clear -> cloud; there is no cloud -> cloud route. Source :135673 permits an action and one charge while holding the staff, without a no-existing-cloud gate. Create a cloud at t=0, then use the printed property again at t=5 minutes while still holding the staff and with charges remaining. The emitted contract rejects the second use until t=10. The second printed swarm has its own ten-minute lifetime; the old cloud's t=10 timer cannot extinguish it at five minutes of age. The prior lifetime patch (magicItemFaithfulLifecycles.ts:409) correctly removed invented dismissal/movement endings but retains this admission restriction. The producer is magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts:866-900; magicItemTriage.ts:96-121 expressly keeps the machine.
(b) Helm of Brilliance: records.json:106048 permits ignite-weapon only inactive -> active. Source :106035 says an action/command can ignite ONE held weapon while the helm has a fire opal, without saying that a previous weapon's flames must first end. Hold weapons A and B, ignite A, then use another action to ignite B while A still burns. The typed machine forbids B's activation. Flames terminate on the selected weapon's drop/stow or the repeated command; the single item-wide active state has no identity with which to preserve A versus B. A self-loop alone would not close this instance/lifetime problem. The retained toggle producer is magicItemSimpleStateMachines.ts:415-432; Lifecycles.ts:1193 changes only its termination wording.

Sibling sweep: inspected all 24 kept graphs / 54 states / 103 edges for direction, repeated admission, target identity, timing and termination; compared source outcomes and the withheld cohort. Glamoured Studded Leather's active -> active reapplication is a correct positive sibling. Source-gated daily activations, green condition-only Rope/Ioun outcomes and Cube face changes/declared same-face ambiguity must retain their own boundaries. The old Apparatus/Eversmoking/Dancing/Broom examples are correctly withheld; that does not certify these retained siblings.

Closure and convergence STOP: this kept-state-machine category has repeated review findings in the same operation-admission class. For these two members, the current 'two states + printed duration/termination' criterion cannot distinguish a faithful toggle from repeated or independently owned effects. The coarse retained representation looks unlikely to converge for these members without resolving that scope/ownership boundary. Per the USER's STOP CONDITION on 19.4.6 and .11, the captain must SURFACE this evidence to the user before proceeding; do not issue another narrow repair or silently reclassify a kept member as adjudicated. A user-authorized resolution must preserve lawful repeated use and source-owned lifetimes in whatever responsibility remains retained, or explicitly revise the selection with the full verbatim spans retained.

Permanent evidence: generalized operation-admission and lifetime-ownership scenarios, including first/repeated use, nonzero elapsed time and two distinct weapon targets; preserve the source-backed wind/ten-minute and weapon drop/stow regressions. This is proportionate to the staged contract and does not require a universal graph prover. Owner 19.4.6; material selected-boundary decision/repair, then fresh full review. No currently green operation is implicated.
S3 — Retained 'safe-use' operation costs turn a printed risky-reuse boundary into an unconditional hard usage limit.
Invariant/authority: user-approved KEEP economies and exact operation/economy cost bindings, faithful-or-absent, owning 19.4.6, ADR 0020's bounded-capability/source-fidelity boundary, and the printed Ring of X-ray Vision and Wind Fan descriptions. A count of risk-free uses may be represented; it must not be asserted as the unconditional resource cost of every use when the source permits further uses with a risk.

Members:
(a) Ring of X-ray Vision: records.json:126403 defines a one-use pool reset on long rest; :126419-126426 binds activate-x-ray-vision to spend one of it unconditionally. Source :126400 instead says EVERY further use before a long rest requires the DC 15 Constitution save or exhaustion. After the first use, source permits a second activation with that save; the typed operation requires one unit from a zero balance.
(b) Wind Fan: records.json:147111 defines one safe use before dawn; :147138-147143 makes cast-gust-of-wind spend one unconditionally. Source :147093 says subsequent uses have a cumulative 20 percent chance of failing/tearing, not that there are no subsequent uses. After the first successful use, the next source-permitted risky cast cannot satisfy the emitted cost.
Both originate in magicItemUseEconomies.ts:548-570 and :602-628. The notes expressly acknowledge that reuse remains allowed, but neither note qualifies the typed operation.cost binding. itemState.ts:2140-2181 always resolves each cost and rejects current.remaining < amount; neither a risk procedure nor the downstream effect changes that prerequisite. These operations remain engine-pending, so this is a retained/staged source claim defect, not a claim of newly green runtime behavior.

Sibling sweep: examined all 150 pools and their operation costs, including ordinary hard once-per-dawn gates, independent properties, safe-use pools, outcome-only Nine Lives loss, per-instance bead disposition, budgets/depletion, variable spends and all seven cooldown pools. The new Djinni/Wings/Efreeti event anchors are correct. Luck Blade's added wish gate and removal of Nine Lives Stealer's unconditional slain-only charge are correct positive contrasts in cost applicability.

Closure: make the retained count and operation binding distinguish the printed safe first use from permitted risky reuse; a clearly bounded safe-use operation may exclude the risky path and carry that path as verbatim DM-adjudicated text, but an unqualified activation/cast cost plus a contradicting note is not exact. Do not implement an entire risky-use executor or broaden global readiness here; preserve the 19-ready set. If the kept-economy shape cannot express that bounded selection cheaply, surface the selection problem under the user's stop condition rather than silently dropping it.

Permanent evidence: generalized first-use/reuse/reset cost-applicability scenarios for this two-member safe-use class, with the printed risk sentence as independent authority and ordinary hard-limit siblings as controls. This directly distinguishes a risk-free-use counter from a total-use allowance; no dedicated proof-platform tests are needed. Owner 19.4.6; material compiler/pack repair and fresh full review.
S4 — Iron Flask still types a DM-adjudicated control clock as a kept grant duration/reversion.
Invariant/authority: the user's triage explicitly keeps creature/count/duration/physical reversion and makes grant control/revert POLICY DM-adjudicated; owning 19.4.6/.6.6, this review's no-adjudicated-category-still-typed requirement, and the printed Iron Flask release paragraph. Keeping the correct number is insufficient when it times the wrong responsibility.

Member: records.json:109968-109980 retains released-flask-creature.duration = {amount:1,unit:'hour'} and revertOn = ['one-hour-control-ended'], even after control/note/exclusivity are removed. Source :109962 says the released creature is FRIENDLY and obeys commands for one hour, then acts according to its normal disposition and alignment. It does not disappear or physically revert after an hour. Scenario: release creature A at t=0; at t=60 minutes A still exists and resumes its normal disposition. The retained marker explicitly describes a control ending, an adjudicated policy responsibility, while the kept duration field presents it alongside actual creature lifetimes such as the Horn's return to Valhalla.
Producer magicItemEntityGrants.ts:400-414 originally coupled these fields to the control policy and a note saying the actor persists. magicItemTriage.ts:1386-1423 blindly retains duration/revertOn, strips that policy context, and therefore leaves this adjudicated-category member typed. The Iron Flask occupancy exception at Triage.ts:1538-1575 protects itemRandomInitialization; that consumer does not require these entityGrant control-clock fields. There is no current grant-lifecycle executor, lowering immediate consequence but not removing the selected source/triage requirement for .12.

Sibling sweep: examined all 29 grants for duration/count/reference/reversion roles and removed-policy fields. Physical timed disappearance/return/reversion remains distinct from control expiry; the elemental conjure-elemental concentration exception, particular-djinni departures, Python reversion, one-or-both individual lions, and linked source tables keep their source responsibilities. Iron Flask is the only retained grant whose revertOn names control ending. This finding does not demand typing any removed control/exclusivity policy.

Closure: remove the one-hour control clock and control-ending marker from the kept creature-lifecycle fields; keep its complete printed friendliness/control-ending paragraph verbatim as adjudicated (it is already carried), and preserve the retained creature/count and initialization occupancy core. Do not turn the printed actor's continued existence into a one-hour removal or add a per-ability policy layer.

Permanent evidence: a generalized grant-duration role invariant with a source-backed control-expiry/persistent-actor case (Iron Flask) and a physical duration-end/return case (Horn or figurine), while preserving current verbatim control/coexistence evidence. The scope is one mistaken responsibility classification; no new executor is required. Owner 19.4.6; material source disposition repair and fresh full review.
No requirement: restoring typed activation targets/triggers, complex withheld topology, grant control/exclusivity, full containment/spellStore/rollManipulation, a per-ability contract layer, or global deterministic closure.
No requirement: malformed-input/typo discovery permutations outside the documented grammar; the user's bd memories typos decision governs.
No requirement: a missing explicit activation cost by itself where the source-backed ordinary spell casting time supplies the same cost; S1(d) concerns non-spell operations with no such fallback.
No requirement: treating the single Deck of Illusions illusion grant's count:1 as a claim of one constituent creature; the printed one-or-more-creatures sentence and referenced table remain carried.
No requirement: requiring arbitrary test-count targets or a dedicated test for every diagnostic/checker.
No requirement: making every already-untyped subsidiary ability into a new operation or economy, or treating a field-shape inventory disposition as semantic certification.

Four blocking defect classes are batched above. All records.json references name packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json; importer file references name packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/. The state-machine convergence concern in S2 must be surfaced to the user under the existing owning/capability bead STOP CONDITION before further implementation, without silently changing the approved keep/adjudicate decision. Other reported field agreement gaps were verifiable cheaply against the printed source; no universal verifier is requested.
